certification_boundary: This receipt proves one retained 25-seat workshop for each September 17 catalog item and 75 participant-level functional journeys started as one concurrent live wave. It covers internal routes and namespace-scoped identities. It does not certify public browser ingress, three consecutive runs, Arena network resilience, or final reclaim of this retained trio.

concurrent_live_proof.note: The isolation assertions apply to Agent 201 and Multi-Agent. The Serve LLMs proof exercises the participant-facing AnythingLLM API and grounded document path.

infrastructure_observation.conclusion: The exact functional pilot gate passed, but correlated node-local and platform-wide probe timeouts make Arena network resilience a release blocker for production certification. OVN, Multus, and ingress remain diagnostic subjects rather than proven root causes. Keep rhgnr1 cordoned outside explicitly supervised certification windows.

post_run_state.multi_agent_restart_note: These were existing Showroom restart counts from prior Arena instability; the functional run ended with every container ready.

proof_strategy.TDD: The evidence contract was first executed RED with the receipt absent. Earlier driver changes were also introduced as failing tests before implementation.
proof_strategy.EDD: The receipt records immutable workshop IDs, clusters, seat counts, participant outcomes, timings, authorization denials, infrastructure warnings, and post-run residue without credentials.
proof_strategy.CDD: Catalog identity, persisted cluster targeting, explicit kubeconfig wrappers, participant result shapes, and this evidence schema are enforced by tests.
proof_strategy.BDD: Given three staggered and retained 25-seat workshops, when 75 participant journeys start as one wave, then every catalog-specific journey succeeds and tested identities remain namespace scoped.
proof_strategy.CBT: Agent 201 tools and UI, Multi-Agent workflow and learner policy, grounded RAG, shared model health, namespace authorization, node state, and residue were validated independently before the combined result was accepted.

red_green_matrix.evidence: The first Arena launcher used mapfile, which macOS Bash 3.2 does not provide; no seat command started.
Portable array collection launched all 50 Arena seat validators; the Brutus validator was already active.
Three distinct workshops remained ready at 25/25 on their persisted clusters.
50/50 tested seats could edit their namespace and were denied cross-namespace reads and node listing.

red_green_matrix.gate: Temporary learner and certification artifact cleanup
red_green_matrix.evidence: Zero workflow-policy ConfigMaps and zero certification pods remained on either execution target.
A platform-wide probe stall affected workloads and OpenShift services during the Multi-Agent restart wave.
All 25 Multi-Agent journeys completed and all 275 containers returned ready without model restarts.
This run used internal participant routes and did not exercise 25 simultaneous external browsers.
The three successful workshops remain intentionally retained for manual review.
